title: Walker SKILL.md: replace hard-coded default with subcommand call and startup info line
definition_of_done: `reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` step 1 no longer hard-codes the default `3`. When `--max-concurrent=N` was passed (`$MAX_FLAG` is set), `MAX` is assigned from the flag and an info line `max_concurrent=$MAX (from --max-concurrent flag)` is printed. Otherwise, `MAX=$(cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency)` is called and `cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency --explain` prints the startup info line.

If `cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency` exits non-zero in step 1, the walker stops and reports the error to the operator with the message "Fix or remove `~/.config/cloverleaf/walker.json` and retry.", consistent with the existing step-0 uncommitted-changes stop-and-report pattern.
Exactly one info line is printed at walker startup on every invocation (flag path, user-config path, or default path).

`reference-impl/tests/skills.test.ts` is extended with 1 new regression case asserting that `cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` step 1 contains both the string `cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency` (plain form) and the string `cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency --explain` (explain form).
All pre-existing tests in `reference-impl/tests/` continue to pass.
acceptance_criteria: `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cloverleaf/walker.json` containing `{ "max_concurrent": 2 }` causes the walker to operate with cap 2 on every invocation without the operator passing `--max-concurrent`.
The walker prints exactly one info line at startup on every invocation naming the resolved value and its source (flag, user config file path, or default).
A malformed `walker.json` causes the walker to stop at step 1 and display a 'Fix or remove' error message rather than silently falling back to the default.
`--max-concurrent=N` passed at invocation time overrides the user config file (precedence: flag > user config > default).
`npm test` in `reference-impl/` passes all tests including the 1 new regression case added by this task in `skills.test.ts`.
